attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, MariaDB 10.11 + galera-4) on previously bare Ubuntu 24.04 nodes, holding an appdb.orders application table. Performed a full maintenance-window shutdown of all three nodes (ordered stop, node1 last with safe_to_bootstrap:1), then a full cold restart (bootstrap node1 via galera_new_cluster, joined node2/node3 via SST), verifying all originally committed rows plus a post-restart write were present and identical across all three members. Then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baseline (boot_id, cluster size 3, Synced) on each node, issued a native reboot per node, confirmed disconnect, polled until reachable, verified changed boot_id, and confirmed each node rejoined with cluster_size=3, Primary/Synced status and correct row count before proceeding to the next node.
